rows.title: Taking it all in…
rows.description: My son and I took a weekend trip up Hwy 395 from Southern California to the Eastern Sierras. We spend one night at Crowley Lake dispersed campground which is the location of this photo. It was a warm afternoon and my son waded out into the water to cool off, I snapped this photo on my Canon EOS 1 with Ektar 100.
